name: Plainproof: Home Inventory
subtitle: Belongings list for insurance
promotional_text: Photograph what you own, note the serial number and what it would cost to replace, and keep a report ready for your insurer. No account, no subscription.
description:
After a fire, a flood or a break-in, an insurer asks for a list of everything you owned, with proof. Plainproof is where you keep that list before you need it.

Go room by room. For each thing, take a photo, note the brand, model and serial number, what you paid and what it would cost to replace, and snap the receipt if you still have it. It takes about a minute an item.

- A report your insurer can use: every item by room with its photo, serial number, purchase details and value, and a total for each room and for the whole home, as a PDF you can send or print
- A spreadsheet of the same details, for an adjuster's own forms
- Rooms you name yourself, with a running total for each
- A list of what still needs a photo, a value or a serial number, so the gaps are easy to close
- Search by name, brand or serial number
- A backup you control: one file with every item and photo, saved wherever you choose and restored on a new iPhone
- Dark mode, and text that follows your iPhone's text size

Nothing leaves your iPhone. There is no account to create and no server: your inventory is stored in the app, and you decide where a report or a backup goes. Keep a backup somewhere other than the phone, since a list that is lost along with the house is no use.

Free for your first 20 items in one place, with every feature. Plainproof Pro removes the limit and adds more places, such as a rental, an office or a storage unit, with one payment. It is not a subscription, and nothing you have added is ever locked: the report and backups keep working when the free version is full.

Values are your own figures. Plainproof does not appraise anything, and insurers differ in what they accept, so ask yours what a claim needs.

support._about: This app's section on the apps' support page (tools/site_pages.py). Every answer must match what the app shows.
support.restore: Open the Settings tab: Restore purchase is in the first group, under Plainproof Pro. It is also at the bottom of the Pro screen.
support.backup: Open the Report tab and scroll down to Backup. Back up now makes one file with every item and photo: save it to iCloud Drive or a computer, or email it to yourself. On the new iPhone, open the Report tab and tap Restore from a backup.

more.q: What does the free version include?
more.a: Every feature, for up to 20 items in one place. Plainproof Pro removes the limit and adds more places (a rental, an office, a storage unit) with one payment. Nothing you have added is ever locked: the report and backups keep working when the free version is full.

more.q: Will my insurer accept the report?
more.a: The report lists every item by room with its photo, serial number, purchase details and value, and a total for each room. Insurers differ in what they ask for, so check with yours. The spreadsheet has the same details in a form an adjuster can sort.
They are your own figures. Enter what it would cost to replace the item; if you leave that empty, the price you paid is used. The app does not appraise anything.

age_rating.note: Draft answers for the age-rating questions; the owner confirms them in App Store Connect.

privacy_label.note: For App Store Connect > App Privacy: 'Data Not Collected'. The app has no server, no account, no analytics and no ads, and since 2026-11-12 it buys Pro straight from the App Store (StoreKit) with no purchase service in between, so nothing is collected by the developer or by any third party the app brings in. Apple's own handling of a purchase is Apple's, and is not declared here.
privacy_label.everything_else: Not collected. Items, photos, receipts, values and notes never leave the device.

products.description: Unlimited items and more places. Pay once.

product_id_note: Store product id = bundle id + '.pro'. The app uses exactly this id (apps/plainproof/src/pro/config.ts) and reads the product, its local price and whether it is owned straight from the App Store on the iPhone. Price and free limit: research/market.md, 'Home inventory'.
